text:
Kai: Kicking off FRA1 rack qualification — need a quick throughput + p95 baseline and kernel/driver sanity before handoff. Goal: automated smoke to catch NVLINK/PCIe regressions and driver mismatches.
Sara: copying notes from prior runs — focus on: driver version, cuda/cuDNN, nvlink topology, dmesg errors, p95 and p99 for 512/1024 token workloads. keep tests <1h.
Matt: +1. I can run the microbench (single-GPU latency sweep) and a 8-GPU stitching throughput test. Suggest scripts: 
```
# check kernel & driver
uname -r && cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
modinfo nvidia | grep -i version
dmesg | egrep -i "nvrm|nvlink|nvidia" | tail -n 200
# topo/links
nvidia-smi topo -m
```
Sara: Also add pci-stub and vfio check for the node images (we saw passthrough flakiness last quarter).
Liam: I'll validate kernel modules and compare against baseline: kernel 6.1.24, nvidia 535.104, cuda 12.1. If mismatch -> mark node quarantined.
Kai: For perf metrics, we need: p50/p95/p99 latency for 512/1024 tokens (beam=1), tokens/s throughput for batched inference (bs=1, bs=4, bs=8), and memory bandwidth saturation check. Put numbers in table.
Matt: Ran single-GPU small model sweep: 512 toks -> p50 48ms, p95 210ms, p99 360ms. 1024 toks -> p50 92ms, p95 395ms. On 8-GPU stitched test we saw aggregate throughput 9100 toks/s (bs8 steady), variance +8% over 30m.
Sara: Thanks. Did you see any NVLINK errors in dmesg?
Matt: No nvlink errors, but PCIe AER warnings on one node (node-fra1-03). Command output: 
```
Apr 10 12:04:11 kernel: pcieport 0000:65:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id 00e0
Apr 10 12:04:11 kernel: pcieport 0000:65:00.0: PCIe Bus Error: severity=Corrected, type=Physical Layer, 
```
Liam: Mark node-fra1-03 degraded and remove from rotation. I'll file a kernel bug if it reproduces.
Kai: For regression detection we need baseline artifacts uploaded: perf logs, nvidia-smi topo, modinfo, dmesg, and a short replay of the 8-GPU workload (20 warmup, 10m steady). Put them in the cluster run dir.
Sara: I've updated the runbook checklist under FRA1 -> /wiki/infra/fra1/qualification (link posted). Steps include: image hash, kernel+driver, nvlink topo, microbench, multi-gpu stitch, net perf check (mtu, tc), and cost projection.
Matt: Quick net perf: between racks p99 RTT 420us, jitter within 25us. Applies to CUDA IPC and NCCL ring stability.
Kai: Cost note — under expected throughput we project ~0.7M tokens/hr per 8-GPU rack at current model mix. Feed that into Dedicated pricing estimate.
Liam: For automation: I'll add a smoke check that fails if p95 increases >20% vs baseline or if any AER/FRU errors appear. Will include these commands in the CI: 
```
# perf check snippet
python infra/tools/bench_infer.py --model small-llm --seq 1024 --batch 8 --duration 600 --report /tmp/fra1-1024.json
# quick logs upload
tar czf /tmp/fra1-artifacts.tgz /var/log/nvidia* /var/log/dmesg /etc/os-release
```
deploy-bot: deployment fra1-qualification/smoke started by Liam at 1968001400. Job id: dq-9843.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Handoff checklist not completed for rack FRA1. Please confirm node list and documented mitigations.
Sara: I'm drafting the handoff note now. Will include: degraded nodes, baseline numbers, failing checks, remediation steps, and links to artifacts.
Kai: Good. Target: finish smoke + artifacts upload by EOD then handoff to eng-sre. If any node shows AER or nvlink errors, escalate to hardware team.
Matt: Will post final summary when dq-9843 finishes (~15m).
Matt: dq-9843 finished. Summary: 7/8 nodes healthy, node-fra1-03 quarantined (PCIe AER). 8-GPU aggregate throughput 8.9M toks/hr (steady), p95 for 1024 = 410ms. Uploading artifacts now.
Sara: Uploaded artifacts to https://wiki.redwood/infra/fra1/artifacts/dq-9843.tar.gz and updated runbook entry. Handoff complete.
Kai: Thanks team. Creating follow-up ticket for hardware swap on node-fra1-03 and a postmortem if it reappears.
oncall-bot: Handoff acknowledged by eng-sre oncall at 1968001777.
